title: reachabilityprobe: Violation.Error prints the pinning package twice, and the pin-extraction error path is dead
summary: Found by comment-reduction batch 29 (2026-09-26) and reported without changing code. (1) (*Violation).Error() prints pathString(v.Cycle) followed by '-> PinningPackage'. Cycle already ends at PinningPackage, so the message reads 'storage -> core -> core'; it should end with the referenced package. (2) extractPins never returns a non-nil error, so the error branches in ExtractFrozenPins and CheckFrozenPins can never fire. (3) The identifier goSourceLiteal should be goSourceLiteral. (4) The package's .apicover-enforce entry lists 4 of its 9 exports, and go/acs/cycle1226's comment says the package imports nothing internal, although it imports sysexec.
fix: End the message with ReferencedPackage, with a test on the exact string. Drop the dead error returns, or make extractPins report unreadable input. Rename the identifier. Refresh the stale descriptions.
acceptance: Violation.Error names each package on the cycle exactly once, ending at the referenced package (test)
priority_rationale: inbox review 2026-09-27: Cosmetic fixes to an error message and an identifier.
